hypothesis: A 4-inference/4-trainer A100-80G topology can complete one grouped RL optimizer update from Flash12, preserve both native DCP and a public portable LoRA, and expose the actual steady-state bottleneck before a larger run.

utilization.limitation: The GPU values are live snapshots, not a sampled run-level average. The trainer MFU uses Prime's full step window, whose denominator includes rollout/judge waiting. No interval GPU telemetry was preserved for this canary.

cost.note: The node total includes bootstrap plus two failed launch attempts on the same rental; it is a provider observation, not an invoice.

failures_and_censored_cases.judge_or_pipeline_exclusions: 28/52 episodes were discarded: four errored and 24 no-signal traces; no stale traces were trained.
failures_and_censored_cases.normal_shutdown_false_positive: The success receipt and upload completed, then the heartbeat supervisor labeled normally exited peer ranks stale while rank 0 finalized. This produced exit 70 despite a passed canary receipt.
failures_and_censored_cases.post_final_dispatch: Only the trainer config was shortened to one step; the orchestrator retained max_steps=20 and dispatched one unnecessary policy-v1 wave during checkpoint finalization.
failures_and_censored_cases.fsdp_warning: PyTorch warned that FSDP-wrapped modules returned views; no in-place-op failure was observed and gradients were finite, but this warning remains a correctness item for later source-level validation.

decision.result: Infrastructure canary passed; no visual improvement claim.
changes_before_next_run: Write explicit per-rank normal-completion markers so peer checkpoint upload cannot trigger a stale-heartbeat failure.
Set trainer and orchestrator canary horizons together to prevent post-final rollout generation.
Use two TP2 inference replicas on the same four A100 inference GPUs; TP5 is incompatible with the model head counts and a three-rank trainer is less safe than the proven FSDP4 trainer.
Keep the four-rank trainer and validate the DP2/TP2 config through pinned Prime before allocation.
Treat rollout/judge collection and the 53.8% discard fraction as the dominant throughput/credit-assignment targets.
